subject: Animation
title: The Toy Story Miracle
description: A 60-second lesson on The Toy Story Miracle.

hook.text: Disney nearly killed Toy Story halfway through production. They said the characters were unlikeable.

buildup.text: Disney's notes had pushed Woody into being a sarcastic bully. The story reels were painful to watch.

discovery.text: Pixar convinced Disney to let them rewrite the script their way. They rebuilt the film from scratch.

twist.text: The team worked around the clock for months. Several animators slept under their desks to meet deadlines.

climax.text: Toy Story opened to universal acclaim and earned $373 million, launching a new era of animation.

punchline.text: A film that nearly died became animation's future.

quiz.question: What crisis did Toy Story face during production?
options: The computer technology broke down completely
Disney nearly cancelled it because studio notes had made the characters unlikeable

details.summary: Toy Story's production was a near-disaster — Disney demanded the film be edgier, resulting in unwatchable test footage. Pixar shut down production, rewrote the script in two weeks with Joss Whedon's help, and delivered a film that changed cinema history.
details.whyItMatters: Toy Story's troubled production reveals that great films often emerge from crisis, not smooth sailing. The willingness to stop, admit failure, and start over is one of the most important creative skills — and Pixar nearly learned it too late.
takeaways: Disney's notes initially pushed Toy Story into an unwatchably mean direction
Pixar stopped production and rewrote the script from scratch in two weeks
The crisis established Pixar's commitment to story integrity over external pressure

faq.question: What went wrong during Toy Story's production?
faq.answer: Disney executive Jeffrey Katzenberg pushed to make Woody more edgy and sarcastic. The resulting Black Friday reel was so unlikeable that Disney nearly shut down production entirely. Woody was mean, Buzz was wooden, and the story lacked heart.

faq.question: How did Pixar fix Toy Story's problems?
faq.answer: They begged Disney for two weeks to rewrite the script, returning to their original vision of Woody as a sympathetic but flawed leader. Joss Whedon helped punch up the dialogue. The new version was warmer, funnier, and emotionally genuine — the Toy Story audiences eventually saw.
